sentences.span: Policymakers delivered a 25bps hike with no dissents, while the dots pointed to...
sentences.why: 25bp hike to 3.75-4% with no dissents confirmed verbatim; range confirmed independently in 17157/17196/17195.

sentences.span: Two-to-three rate hikes (including September's move) therefore, appears to be a sensible middle ground... The market is somewhat more hawkish; it is currently pricing a further three 25bp hikes (four including the September increase). We view this as likely to be the limit for tightening... a total of 100bp of rate hikes would leave the funds rate around 150bp above the Fed's estimate of its longer-run, or neutral level.
sentences.why: HSBC's own base case is 'two-to-three' hikes total, called a 'sensible middle ground,' not a 'ceiling.' The 100bp/150bp-above-neutral figures are attached in the source to the MARKET's more hawkish pricing of four total hikes, which HSBC separately calls 'the limit' -- a different, larger count than 'two to three.' The sentence wrongly grafts that rationale onto the two-to-three figure.

sentences.span: our anticipated hike in March 2027 may not materialize and the Fed only hikes one more time in December. An even more rapid de-escalation of the Middle East conflict or faster disinflation than we project could mean a one-and-done hike in December
sentences.why: Faster de-escalation or quicker disinflation converge on one remaining hike, in December, per MS's own scenario language.

sentences.span: Per MS, the Top 20% holds $49.8tn in equity wealth against just $8.3tn in labor income, while the bottom 40% has $1.8tn in labor income versus $1.7tn in equity wealth.

our CY30E server CPU TAM to $210bn+ (from ~$170bn) ... agentic inference is pushing the CPU-to-GPU ratio from ~1:4 in the training era to, ~1:2 for AI inference, and ultimately toward ~1:1 for agentic AI ... CPUs representing ~10% of the overall ~$2.2Tn data center systems TAM

sentences.span: If the Fed has to do materially more, GIR sees ~$4,070 in a three-additional-hike scenario
sentences.why: Matches; Goldman is the attributed bank.

sentences.span: The big structural story remains intact: central banks are buying at more than 5x the pre-2022 pace.
sentences.why: The '5x pre-2022 pace' claim belongs to Goldman's GIR note (17230), not Societe Generale. SocGen's own document (17214) shows a Russia-reserve-freeze annotation only on a narrower China-PBoC gold chart, and elsewhere in that same document states central bank net gold purchasing 'slowed in 2025' and central bank demand share fell from 37% to 20% -- it does not assert a 5x-pace figure or trace it directly to the Feb 2022 freeze. The sentence misattributes the bank and invents a causal chain not present in either source.
